title: Strategy development..
author: Fantastic-Dig7955
selftext:
I'm looking for traders who have successfully converted their own trading strategies into TradingView Pine Script indicators and are using them profitably.

I have several trading strategies that are currently performing well, but I need help transforming them into reliable Pine Script indicators. In return, I'm happy to collaborate, share ideas, test concepts, and contribute to development.

The goal is to build a small network of serious traders who can help each other automate strategies, improve backtesting, refine indicators, and work toward greater consistency and profitability.

If you have experience with Pine Script and strategy development, feel free to comment or send me a message. Let's collaborate, learn from each other, and turn proven trading ideas into powerful tools.
